data.long_meaning: Fawzah is derived from the Arabic word 'fawza' which means 'conquering' or 'victorious'. It is a name with a rich history and cultural significance, evoking images of strength and triumph in the face of adversity. The name Fawzah carries the meaning “Conquering, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fawzah usually hope their child will grow to embody conquering, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
